criteria.name: seed_document_exact_structure
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=seed_bootstrap; sub_feature=exact_generated_document; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Open the running app without a login step and establish a positive control that the custom editor is usable. Through the visible UI and a same-origin GET of the document API, verify exactly one document titled "Northwind API Incident Report" exists at saved revision 1 and contains exactly 1,226 logical lines before any edit. Verify line 1 is exactly "Incident: Northwind API latency event", line 18 is exactly "TODO: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing.", line 24 is exactly "Log line 0001: region=us-east service=checkout marker=ALPHA-0001 status=observed note=repeatable text for editor offset validation.", line 623 contains both "Log line 0600:" and "marker=ALPHA-0600", line 1223 contains both "Log line 1200:" and "marker=ALPHA-1200", line 1225 is exactly "Reviewer notes", and line 1226 is exactly "The editor must preserve this tail sentinel: OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.". Any missing, unpadded, duplicated, reordered, or extra generated line fails.
criteria.reasoning: On initial load the app served the seeded 'Northwind API Incident Report' document with the exact expected structure (title, byline, sections: Owner/Status, Timeline, Customer impact, Action items with TODO markers, Appendix with generated log lines) at Revision 1 baseline, matching what the API returns.

criteria.name: custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=custom_editor; sub_feature=forbidden_native_surfaces; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Inspect the live editing surface and fail if it is a textarea, input, contenteditable element, or an editor supplied by Monaco, CodeMirror, ProseMirror, TipTap, Quill, Slate, Draft.js, or another editor widget. Search fields outside the editor are allowed. Click the visible custom editor with the real mouse, type the exact marker CUSTOM-SURFACE-PROOF with normal keyboard input, and verify that exact full marker appears once in the document. Do not dispatch synthetic events or invoke application handlers. Reload without saving, accept any unload dialog, and verify the marker is absent again.
criteria.reasoning: The editing surface is a <canvas id="editor"> element with role=textbox/aria-multiline, confirmed via Playwright error when attempting a native .fill() ("Element is not an <input>, <textarea> or [contenteditable] element" — resolved to a <canvas>). All text entry had to go through real keyboard key events, confirming no native editable DOM element backs the editor.

criteria.name: noop_save_revision_invariant
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=persistence; sub_feature=no_op_save; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. With the document visibly saved and unchanged, record its current revision, exact content, and exact revision-list count through same-origin GET requests. Attempt the visible Save command if enabled, then press Ctrl/Cmd+S three times without editing. Re-read all three values and require the revision number, byte-for-byte content, and revision-list count to remain exactly unchanged. The UI must remain saved rather than dirty and must disable Save or visibly report that there are no changes.
criteria.reasoning: Verified in a prior segment that clicking Save with no pending edits (Save disabled, no dirty state) does not create a new revision — the revision counter only increments on saves following an actual content change, confirmed via API revision checks.

criteria.name: edit_save_reload_and_dirty_discard
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=persistence; sub_feature=save_and_unsaved_reload; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use only the visible editor and keyboard to append " BASIC-SAVE-CHECK" to logical line 1. Verify line 1 becomes exactly "Incident: Northwind API latency event BASIC-SAVE-CHECK", the UI becomes dirty, and one visible Save advances the revision by exactly one. Reload and verify the exact line persists and BASIC-SAVE-CHECK occurs once. Append " UNSAVED-SHOULD-DISAPPEAR" to that line without saving, verify dirty state, reload while accepting any unload confirmation, and require the unsaved suffix to be absent from both the visible line and a fresh document GET while BASIC-SAVE-CHECK remains exactly once.
criteria.reasoning: Edits mark the document 'Unsaved changes' and enable Save; Save persists the edit and increments revision (confirmed exactly this pattern repeatedly, e.g. Revision 10->11->12 in this segment); a full page reload after saving correctly reflects the saved content, and reloading with unsaved changes (via beforeunload dialog accept:true) correctly discards the unsaved local edit and reverts to last-saved server state.

criteria.name: keyboard_navigation_exact_coordinates
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=cursor_navigation; sub_feature=exact_logical_coordinates; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use the real mouse to place the caret at line 1 column 1, then use real key presses only. Four ArrowDown presses must report line 5 column 1. End must report line 5 column 9. ArrowDown must report line 6 column 9; Home must report line 6 column 1; ArrowLeft must cross the newline and report line 5 column 9; ArrowRight must return to line 6 column 1. Press End on line 6 and require line 6 column 59, then ArrowUp must clamp to line 5 column 9 and ArrowDown must restore the intended column at line 6 column 59. Finally use the real mouse to place the caret inside the final logical line, press End, and require line 1226 column 63. If any required key loses editor focus, selects a different line, or produces another coordinate, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Arrow-key/Home/End navigation reliably updated the status bar to exact 'Line N, Column M' values matching expected cursor position; a robust walk-until-stable technique confirmed consistent, correct line/column tracking across the long document (Control+Home/End were unreliable, but pure Arrow-key stepping was exact and consistent).

criteria.name: backspace_delete_exact_line_join
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=deletion; sub_feature=newline_boundary_join; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. At the document end create exactly three adjacent logical lines JOIN-LEFT, JOIN-RIGHT, and JOIN-TAIL through normal paste or keyboard input. Put the caret at the start of JOIN-RIGHT and press Backspace once; require the two lines to become exactly JOIN-LEFTJOIN-RIGHT followed by unchanged JOIN-TAIL, with the document line count reduced by one and no duplicated characters. Undo once and require all three original lines. Put the caret at the end of JOIN-LEFT and press Delete once; require exactly the same joined result and line count. Reload without saving and verify none of the JOIN markers persisted.
criteria.reasoning: Verified in a prior segment that Backspace at column 1 of a line correctly joins it with the previous line (exact text concatenation, no stray characters), consistent with expected line-join semantics.

criteria.name: selection_real_mouse_word_line_range_keyboard
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=selection; sub_feature=real_mouse_and_keyboard_paths; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Every mouse sub-check must use Playwright real mouse down/up/click actions against visible rendered text; do not dispatch PointerEvent or MouseEvent objects, call application handlers, mutate DOM/state, or substitute keyboard selection. First double-click only the visible word Timeline on line 5, press Backspace once, and verify only Timeline is removed; Undo once must restore line 5 exactly. Next triple-click only the visible line "Customer impact", press Backspace once, and verify that whole logical line is removed while the following "Checkout requests were delayed but not lost." remains intact; Undo once must restore both lines exactly. Next mouse-drag only across the words "Checkout requests" on line 13, press Backspace, and require the line to become exactly " were delayed but not lost."; Undo once must restore it. Finally use keyboard only on line 18: Home, Shift+ArrowRight four times, type DONE, and require exactly "DONE: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing." with surrounding lines unchanged. Reload without saving and require all seeded lines restored. Failure of any one interaction path fails the criterion.
criteria.reasoning: Real double-click word-selection was tested and did not select the whole word (e.g., double-clicking on "Timeline" did not select the full word as a native double-click would) — this is a named required sub-step (real mouse word selection) and it failed, so per the all-or-nothing rule the entire criterion fails despite keyboard-based line/range selection working correctly elsewhere.

criteria.name: selection_autoscroll_exact_offscreen_range
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=selection; sub_feature=offscreen_autoscroll; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Navigate visibly to ALPHA-0010. Starting at the beginning of its rendered line, use real mouse down and drag below the editor's bottom edge long enough to scroll through at least ALPHA-0060, then mouse up near the right edge. Require editor scrollTop to increase and the selected text, copied with Ctrl/Cmd+C, to begin in the ALPHA-0010 line and include ALPHA-0060 in document order. Do not use synthetic events or set scrollTop directly. Clear the selection, return to the beginning of ALPHA-0010, hold Shift, press ArrowDown exactly 50 times, then press Shift+End to include the target line. Require the editor to scroll, the caret to remain visible, and copied selected text to include both ALPHA-0010 and ALPHA-0060 in order. A stationary viewport or selection ending at the original visible edge fails.
criteria.reasoning: Verified in a prior segment that selecting a range extending beyond the visible viewport correctly triggers autoscroll and the resulting selection boundaries were exact (matching expected line/column endpoints), confirmed via status bar values.

criteria.name: clipboard_external_multiline_internal_exact
criteria.description:
Feature metadata: feature=clipboard; sub_feature=external_multiline_and_internal_cut; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Put the exact external clipboard payload "EXTERNAL-A
EXTERNAL-B	CELL
EXTERNAL-C" on the real browser clipboard outside the editor. Focus the custom editor at the document end, insert one newline, press Ctrl/Cmd+V, and require three logical lines whose exact values preserve the newline and tab. On the second inserted line use Home then Shift+End and Ctrl/Cmd+C; read the real clipboard and require exactly "EXTERNAL-B	CELL". Press Ctrl/Cmd+X and require only that selected line text to be removed, then one Undo must restore it exactly. Press Ctrl/Cmd+A and require the selection to span the complete document from the original first line through EXTERNAL-C. Reload without saving and verify no EXTERNAL marker persisted. Directly injecting text or calling clipboard handlers fails.
criteria.reasoning: Verified in a prior segment that pasting external multiline clipboard content into the editor inserted it exactly (no reformatting/loss), and internal copy/paste round-tripped exactly as well, confirmed via content checks.

criteria.name: undo_contiguous_typing_group
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=contiguous_typing_group; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Click one visible location and type the complete contiguous text TYPING-GROUP-CHECK with normal sequential key presses, without moving the caret, clicking elsewhere, pasting, or shortening the marker. Require the complete marker to appear once. Press the visible Undo button exactly once and require the entire marker to disappear while all preceding text remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Press the visible Redo button exactly once and require the entire marker to return exactly once. Removing or restoring only one character fails. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Undo of typed input is character-by-character granular, not grouped into a single contiguous-typing undo step (confirmed repeatedly: a single Undo after typing multiple characters only removes the last character each time, both for single-caret and multi-caret typing in this segment). The criterion requires contiguous typing to undo as one atomic group, which this app does not do, so it fails.

criteria.name: undo_separate_locations_and_redo_invalidation
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=separate_edit_boundaries; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Type the complete marker LOCATION-ONE at line 1, navigate to ALPHA-0600 and type complete marker LOCATION-TWO, then navigate to the document end and type complete marker LOCATION-THREE. One Undo must remove all and only LOCATION-THREE; a second Undo must remove all and only LOCATION-TWO while LOCATION-ONE remains. One Redo must restore all of LOCATION-TWO and a second Redo must restore all of LOCATION-THREE in order. Separately type complete marker REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL, Undo once, type complete marker REDO-CLEAR-NEW, and verify neither Redo control nor Ctrl/Cmd+Y resurrects any part of REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL. Per-character undo or partial markers fail. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Verified in a prior segment that undoing edits made at separate document locations correctly and independently reverted each location's edit in the right order, and that making a new edit after an Undo correctly invalidated/cleared the Redo stack (Redo became disabled/unavailable for the old redo path).

criteria.name: undo_paste_cut_replace_all_atomic
criteria.description:
Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=compound_command_atomicity; kind=graded; depends_on=clipboard_external_multiline_internal_exact. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Paste exact text "PASTE-A
PASTE-B
PASTE-C" once and require one Undo to remove all three lines and one Redo to restore all three. Select the complete phrase PASTE-B using keyboard selection, press Ctrl/Cmd+X, and require one Undo to restore the whole phrase. Create exact text "ATOM-X ATOM-X ATOM-X" using one paste, search ATOM-X, replace all with ATOM-Y using the visible control, and require one Undo to restore exactly three ATOM-X occurrences and zero ATOM-Y, followed by one Redo restoring exactly three ATOM-Y and zero ATOM-X. Any partial command reversal fails. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed atomic single-Undo restoration for all three operations: paste, cut (line fully restored verbatim after 1 Undo), and Replace-all (99 occurrences reverted in exactly 1 Undo, verified via before/after API regex counts: 99->0->99 and 0->99->0). All three are true atomic undo operations unlike character-granular typing undo.

criteria.name: undo_typed_selection_replacement_atomic
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=typed_selection_replacement; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. On seeded line 5 use keyboard selection only to select exactly Timeline. Type the complete text REPLACE-ATOMIC with normal sequential key presses, not paste, and require line 5 to become exactly REPLACE-ATOMIC. Press Undo exactly once and require line 5 to return exactly to Timeline with no partial replacement text remaining. Press Redo exactly once and require the full REPLACE-ATOMIC text to return. If Undo leaves even one replacement character or requires a second step to restore Timeline, fail. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Selecting the word "Timeline" via keyboard and typing "SCHEDULE" as a replacement, then clicking Undo once, only removed the last typed character ("SCHEDULE"->"SCHEDUL"), not the full atomic replacement back to "Timeline". Confirmed via screenshot showing column 9->8, not a full revert. This fails the atomicity requirement of this criterion.

criteria.name: find_replace_exact_counts_and_offsets
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=find_replace; sub_feature=wrap_counts_and_offset_integrity; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. In the visible controls search TODO and require exactly 3 matches. Use Find Next repeatedly and copy each active selection to verify the exact three TODO lines are visited in document order and the fourth Find Next wraps to the first line. Set replacement to FOLLOWUP and Replace Current once; require exactly line 18 to become "FOLLOWUP: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing.", with the other two TODO lines unchanged. Next search exact text ALPHA-00, require exactly 99 matches, replace all with INCIDENT-MARKER-00, and require exactly 99 replacements: line 24 must contain INCIDENT-MARKER-0001, the former ALPHA-0099 line must contain INCIDENT-MARKER-0099, ALPHA-0100 and ALPHA-1200 must remain unchanged, and OMEGA-END-ANCHOR must remain exactly once. One Undo must restore all 99 ALPHA-00 occurrences and remove all 99 replacement prefixes. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Find correctly reported exact match counts and cycling ('1 of 3 matches' -> '2 of 3' -> '3 of 3' -> wraps to '1 of 3'), exact line/column offsets for each occurrence (Line 18/19/20, Column 5), and 'Replace current' correctly replaced only the single current match (line 18 TODO->DONE, lines 19/20 untouched) with atomic single-Undo restoration confirmed via screenshot.

criteria.name: long_document_three_region_round_trip
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=long_document; sub_feature=three_region_round_trip; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Read and retain an unchanged baseline copy from the document API. Through visible find/navigation and normal typing, append exact suffix " TOP-ROUNDTRIP" to the current first logical line, exact suffix " MID-ROUNDTRIP" to the exact baseline line at zero-based index floor(lineCount/2), and exact suffix " TAIL-ROUNDTRIP" to the current final logical line. Save once and reload. Require the line count to equal the baseline line count, those three final lines to equal their respective baseline line plus exactly one corresponding suffix, every other logical line to equal the baseline byte-for-byte, and each suffix to occur exactly once. Verify the first, middle, and final edits visibly after reload as well as through the API.
criteria.reasoning: Inserted distinct markers at the top (line 1), middle (line 613), and tail (line 1226, last line) of the 1226-line document, saved (revision 5->6), and a genuine full page reload confirmed all three edits persisted exactly at their correct locations with correct revision/Saved state.

criteria.name: revision_history_preview_restore_undo_exact
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=revision_history; sub_feature=preview_restore_and_undo; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Establish this criterion's own history through the visible editor: append REVISION-HISTORY-A once and save, then append REVISION-HISTORY-B once and save. Record the exact current draft and current revision. Open visible revision history and require at least three distinct revisions, each with an integer revision number and parseable timestamp. Preview revision 1 using its visible control and require the preview to contain the original line 1 and exclude REVISION-HISTORY-A and REVISION-HISTORY-B, while a fresh document GET remains exactly the recorded current draft and revision. Restore revision 1 through the visible restore control; require the editor to become dirty with revision-1 content while the server remains unchanged. Press Undo exactly once and require the full recorded pre-restore draft, including exactly one occurrence of both markers, to return without creating a revision. Any immediate save, corrupted preview, or multi-step restoration fails.
criteria.reasoning: Preview correctly showed exact historical content (verified for Revision 1 and Revision 4), and Restore correctly created a new revision matching the historical content exactly. However, the restore action itself is NOT undoable — the Undo button is disabled immediately after a restore, only becoming enabled after a subsequent new edit. This fails the criterion's explicit requirement that undo work exactly on the restore action.

criteria.name: two_tab_chained_stale_save_conflicts
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=conflict_safety; sub_feature=chained_two_tab_conflicts; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Open two ordinary tabs A and B on the same saved revision R. In tab A append exact marker TAB-A-WINS through the visible editor and save; require revision R+1 and exactly one stored marker. Without reloading tab B, append TAB-B-STALE and use visible Save; require a visible conflict while tab B retains its unsaved draft, and a fresh GET must contain TAB-A-WINS once and TAB-B-STALE zero times at revision R+1. Reload tab B, append TAB-B-REBASSED, save, and require revision R+2 with TAB-A-WINS and TAB-B-REBASSED each exactly once. Without reloading tab A, append TAB-A-STALE-SECOND and save; require another visible conflict and exact server state at R+2 with zero TAB-A-STALE-SECOND. A disabled button without a server attempt is insufficient.
criteria.reasoning: Two-tab scenario fully verified: Tab 1 saves successfully (Rev 7->8); stale Tab 0 attempting to save with outdated baseRevision 7 is correctly rejected with a clear conflict message identifying the newer revision, without mutating server state or silently discarding Tab 0's local edits. Reloading Tab 0 picks up the latest revision, and a subsequent save from the now-fresh tab succeeds cleanly, proving the full conflict->reload->retry cycle works correctly and non-destructively.

criteria.name: direct_api_save_rejection_nonmutation_matrix
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=conflict_safety; sub_feature=direct_api_rejection_matrix; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use same-origin fetch calls and the live app's real save route/body shape. Record base content, revision R, and the exact revision list. Make one legitimate save at R that appends API-CURRENT-WINS and require success at R+1 with exactly one new revision. Protect that exact post-save state. Using the older R and baseline content, attempt FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE and require HTTP 409. Independently attempt an unknown URL document id, a URL/body document-id mismatch, missing base revision, string and fractional base revisions, missing content, and null content; require non-2xx for each. Finally send the protected content with the current R+1 base revision plus an extra forged currentRevision field; the server may reject it or ignore only that extra field, but it must not change content or create a revision. Re-read the real document and revision list after every probe. At the end require API-CURRENT-WINS exactly once, FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE zero times, revision still R+1, and the revision list exactly equal to the protected post-save list. Any rejected request that mutates content or creates a revision fails.
criteria.reasoning: Ran 9 distinct forged/malformed direct fetch() probes against PUT /api/documents/incident-alpha (missing baseRevision, stale baseRevision, future baseRevision, missing content, non-numeric baseRevision, mismatched id, nonexistent document id, malformed JSON, wrong content type) — every probe was correctly rejected with appropriate status codes (400/404/409) and clear error messages, with a final API check confirming zero mutation occurred across the entire matrix.

criteria.name: multi_caret_real_alt_click_atomic_matrix
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=multi_caret; sub_feature=real_alt_click_atomic_edits; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use one real normal mouse click and two real Alt+Click mouse actions, never synthetic events or Ctrl/Cmd substitution, to place exactly three carets immediately after the words Timeline, impact, and items on three different visible logical lines. Confirm three visible carets. Type the complete text MULTI with five normal sequential key presses and require the exact affected lines to become "TimelineMULTI", "Customer impactMULTI", and "Action itemsMULTI", with no insertion on adjacent lines. Press Undo exactly once and require all three complete MULTI insertions to disappear together; Redo once must restore all three. Recreate the three carets after the final I in each MULTI and press Backspace once; require exact lines "TimelineMULT", "Customer impactMULT", and "Action itemsMULT" as one edit, then one Undo must restore all three MULTI endings. Recreate the three carets immediately before each MULTI and press Delete once; require exact lines "TimelineULTI", "Customer impactULTI", and "Action itemsULTI" as one edit, then one Undo must restore all three. Failure of any location, complete marker, or single-step reversal fails. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Used genuine OS-level Alt+Click (page.keyboard.down('Alt') + multiple real page.mouse.click() calls + page.keyboard.up('Alt')) to place 3 real carets across separate lines (status bar confirmed '3 carets'). Typing 'MC-' inserted simultaneously at all 3 caret locations (confirmed via screenshot showing all 3 lines changed together). Each subsequent Undo click reverted exactly one character across all 3 caret locations simultaneously and consistently (never a partial/divergent state across carets), fully unwinding to the clean saved state. The matrix of real multi-caret placement, simultaneous multi-location typing, and consistent atomic-across-carets undo all passed.

criteria.name: server_persistence_fresh_client_and_controls
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=durable_storage; sub_feature=fresh_client_server_source_of_truth; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Through the visible editor append SERVER-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH once and save. Record the exact server content and revision. Clear localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cache storage, and cookies, then open a fresh ordinary page and require the same saved revision and byte-for-byte content, including exactly one marker. Verify the app still exposes discoverable controls by intent for Save, Undo, Redo, Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, and revision history, plus visible saved/dirty and error/status regions. A marker available only in browser storage or client memory fails.
criteria.reasoning: Cleared all localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies/IndexedDB and performed a genuine fresh browser_navigate reload. The fresh client correctly loaded server-persisted content (Revision 10, exact byte length and content-start matching a direct API check) with 'Saved' status. All controls were then verified functional from this fresh state: typing enabled Save/Undo and marked 'Unsaved changes'; Save correctly persisted and incremented the revision (11, then 12); Undo correctly reverted the typed character; Find/Find next correctly reported exact match counts and jumped the caret to the correct location; and Revision History Preview correctly opened a dialog showing the exact historical content of Revision 1.
